summary: Iter143 verification — 4/5 features PASS, 1 CRITICAL route bug. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (testimonials/submit-authenticated + /my + duplicate rejection; super-admin/comprehensive-report shape + 12-month trend + custom months + resident/unauth 403). Frontend: ✅ Referral WhatsApp button (wa.me + text= + 15% + #25D366 brand color), ✅ Blog 3 new slugs render with h1/h2/tables/lists, ✅ Dark Mode on /pricing+/login+/blog (dark class, body bg rgb(11,18,32), login inputs rgb(55,65,81)), ✅ Super Admin Comprehensive Report UI fully renders (comprehensive-report + 4 KPI cards + Recharts AreaChart + plans-table + top-compounds + CSV btn). ❌ /pricing PUBLIC route MISSING — visiting /pricing renders blank with React Router warning 'No routes matched location "/pricing"'. The Pricing component is currently mounted ONLY as path="pricing" nested under /app/*, requiring auth — directly contradicts the spec which mandates a public /pricing route with the new testimonials carousel.

ui_bugs.issue: Public route /pricing does NOT exist. Route is registered as <Route path="pricing" element={<Pricing />} /> NESTED INSIDE the /app/* layout (App.js line 897), so the real URL is /app/pricing which requires auth and redirects to /login. Visiting public /pricing shows a blank gradient page with console warning 'No routes matched location "/pricing"'. This blocks BOTH testid checks (data-testid='pricing-testimonials' / 'testimonials-section' / 'share-testimonial-btn' / 'first-testimonial-btn') from being verifiable on the public route per spec.

action_items: ADD a public-level route for /pricing in App.js (outside the /app/* nested layout). Suggested fix near the public legal routes (~line 698-702): <Route path="/pricing" element={<Pricing />} />. The CustomerTestimonialsCarousel component itself is correctly implemented with all required testids — it just isn't reachable on a public URL.

rca_of_the_issue: Pricing.js route was placed inside the authenticated /app/* layout instead of the public route group. App.js line 730 opens <Route path='/app' element={<Layout>…}>, lines 731-1112 are nested children, and line 897 has <Route path='pricing'> — so the route is /app/pricing (auth-protected). React Router emits 'No routes matched location "/pricing"' and renders the fallback (blank gradient). FIX: duplicate the route at the public level alongside /about, /contact, /testimonials/submit (around line 700) as <Route path='/pricing' element={<Pricing />} />. No data or schema change needed.
